law: P-88 (packages/core/src/foundation/contracts/kernel/common/index.ts, owner ruling 2026-10-06): a component with a skin of its own keeps its canonical data-part/data-state on its root and trigger; a caller value can neither replace them nor be forwarded to an element the component paints. Composition goes through the documented className/slot hooks; only a structural component with no part of its own may forward.
purpose: The WO-ARC-12 fleet ratchet. It closes the roster of elements where a caller data-part/data-state still lands (passThroughViolations), and the per-family sets of callers whose owner skins would lose paint the day a child family strips caller parts/states (callerPartDependents / callerStateDependents). Those sets are the step-2 engine-lot preconditions, as machine-readable rows.
policy: decrease-only to 0, the family-cut ledger policy: every count may shrink and must then be lowered here, and none may ever grow. The only door is `node scripts/check/engine/skins/pass-through/index.mjs --update-baseline`. It writes the gate's own measurement, keeps the routing prose of surviving held entries, and refuses if anything grew. A pin is never hand-computed. A pin follows the tree down; an instrument-coverage re-pin to the gate's own measurement, with a cutNote and independent review, is the only lawful raise.

keys: Line-free. Sites and tripwires: <file>#<owning component>#<tag>#<canonical part|none>#<ordinal>. Dependents: <file>#<child component>#<caller part|none>#<ordinal>. The ordinal counts elements sharing the first four fields in source order, so a line shift elsewhere never churns a key.
eligibilityRule: A child family's part-strip engine lot is eligible iff its `part` set is empty; its state-strip lot iff its `state` set is empty. Layout carriers (carrier: true) wait on the owner's carrier ruling (§6) whatever their sets say. A held entry names its routing; the typography engine lot's ruled precondition is exactly its held set.
tripwireHistory: Census v2 excluded 10 unpainted wrappers. The v3 amended condition (e)(iv) (component-authored inline style or an Ant/engine-owned paint root counts as paint) returned 8 of them to the counted roster, where they are listed below in `returnedToRosterInV3`. Since v3 the tripwire set is these 2 keys. A tripwire re-enters the count the moment a DS class, stamped part, skin selector or component paint reaches it; a NEW unpainted row is refused.
